question: Is one knower ever complete alone, or through part-of-parts?
premises: knower, not full, just one — if by part-of-part order
inference: Single knower is incomplete; part-gathered knowledges circle unbroken discernment.
uncertainties: amsamsika reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Knower, not full, just one — if by part-of-part order, having taken knowledges, would make discernment, unbroken circle.
